_written: 2026-10-09, before running gen15. Adaptive/regime/ML layers on the gen13 futures survivors.
evaluation: expanding walk-forward, refit every January using data through Dec 31 of the prior year; out-of-sample decision window 1995-01-01..2013-12-31 (end of DISCOVERY + all VALIDATION). 2014-2024 reported as CONTAMINATED-SECONDARY (TEST/HOLDOUT already looked at in gen13). Status ceiling: PROMISING_BUT_UNVALIDATED.
sleeves: TREND = mean of F0,F1,F2 signals; CARRY = F3 signal; each run through the panel engine with costs (book vol target 10%). Baseline B0 = 50/50 equal-risk mix of the two sleeve P&Ls (= F7-like).
overlays_weight_daily_pnl: weights decided with information through day t multiply sleeve P&L from day t+1; reweighting costs ignored (stated limitation)

H15a_HMM_REGIME.model: 2-state Gaussian HMM (hmmlearn) on weekly [LONG_RP return, log 20d realised vol of LONG_RP]; state probabilities by the FORWARD filter only (no smoothing)
H15a_HMM_REGIME.rule: in each training window estimate each sleeve's Sharpe per state (state assignment by filtered argmax); OOS weight of sleeve k in state s proportional to max(Sharpe_k,s, 0), equal if both <= 0

H15b_BOCPD_DERISK.model: Adams-MacKay Bayesian online change-point on B0 daily P&L, Normal-Gamma prior, hazard 1/250
H15b_BOCPD_DERISK.rule: scale B0 to 0.5 when P(run length < 21 days) > 0.5, else 1.0

H15c_FACTOR_MOMENTUM.rule: weight sleeves by max(trailing-252d sleeve Sharpe, 0) (equal if both <= 0)
H15c_FACTOR_MOMENTUM.source: Ehsani & Linnainmaa (2022) Factor momentum and the momentum factor, JF

H15d_ML.target: sum of instrument returns over days t+2..t+21 divided by sigma_t
H15d_ML.features: sign tsmom 21/63/126/252; EWMAC raw 4 speeds; carry signal; sigma; sigma/sigma 252d-mean; 126d skew; distance to 252d high/low in sigma units; asset-class code

models.H15d_LGBM: LightGBM regressor, 200 trees, num_leaves 15, learning_rate 0.03, min_data_in_leaf 500, feature_fraction 0.8, seed 0

H15d_ML.sampling: train on every 5th day; purge the last 22 days before each refit
H15d_ML.position: clip(pred / mean|pred on training|, -1, 1) through the panel engine with costs
H15d_ML.baseline: F7_COMBO signal on the same OOS years

adopt_if.overlays (a,b,c): OOS 1995-2013 net Sharpe >= B0 + 0.10 AND above the 95th percentile of 200 random overlays with the same distribution of weights (shuffled in blocks of 63 days)
adopt_if.ML (d): OOS 1995-2013 net Sharpe >= F7 + 0.10 AND block-bootstrap P(Sharpe_ML <= Sharpe_F7) < 0.10; LGBM must also beat RIDGE (complexity must earn its keep)
